title: A number changed on the Part Library page reaches an open part request
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBOPEN-01) is active at {Location-A}.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open, for a ZZAUTOTEST customer.
  • Its line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL lib open line") holds a part request for {Part-A}, quantity 1, not yet received.
  • The new number {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBOPEN-01N) is not used by any Part Library entry.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Replace the Part Number with {Number-A}.
  6. Click Save.
  7. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  8. Open {Work-order-1}.
  9. Look at the part row on {Line-1}.
  10. Click the Parts tab of {Work-order-1}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: The change is saved.
  • Step 9: The part request on {Line-1} now shows {Number-A}, with the same description, quantity and status as before.
  • Step 10: The Parts tab lists the request under {Number-A}, and {Part-A} is not shown.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S11-R3a, S13-R19, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), board 2.3 (Saved: the list shows the new values), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-R19: “A rename carries over to open work that holds this part, at every location: purchase order lines not yet fully received, part requests not yet received or returned, canned jobs, and returns that are not completed take the new number. A delivery that is not yet accepted is covered by its open purchase order lines. Receiving, ordering, applying a canned job and returning then find the renamed part.”
